articles.summary: This year, Whatnot will bring live shopping to the center of New York Comic Con (NYCC) with the debut of the Whatnot Liveplex, a 5,000-square-foot, shopping mall-inspired activation at the Javits Center. From October 8–11, the Liveplex will spotlight the people shaping what’s next in comics, collect
articles.title: Introducing Whatnot Liveplex: NYCC’s Live Shopping Mall
